name: Mangrove forest
definition: Salt-tolerant trees and shrubs growing in the intertidal zone of tropical coasts and estuaries.

name: Intertidal mud & sand flats
definition: Unvegetated or sparsely vegetated areas exposed at low tide.

name: Seagrass beds
definition: Submerged meadows of flowering marine plants in shallow coastal waters.

name: Estuarine waters
definition: Waters where river and sea mix, including rias (drowned river valleys).

name: Shallow marine waters
definition: Permanent shallow coastal and marine waters.

name: Coastal lagoons
definition: Shallow coastal water bodies separated from the sea by barriers, often brackish.

name: Sandy beaches
definition: Sandy shores, including sea-turtle nesting beaches.

name: Palm groves, forest & savanna
definition: Terrestrial mosaic of palm groves, dry or semi-dry forest and woodland savanna.

name: Lakes
definition: Permanent or seasonal bodies of standing fresh or saline water inland.

name: Floodplains
definition: Land beside rivers that is seasonally flooded, including flooded grasslands.

name: Marshes and swamps
definition: Freshwater wetlands dominated by herbaceous plants (marshes) or trees (swamps), such as papyrus or reed beds.
